definitions.meaning: to lead, lead out, withdraw, take away

quotations.english: I am led out from the light

definitions.meaning: to be produced, brought forth, to grow

quotations.old_english: Ðú of foldan fódder neátum lǽtest alǽdan
quotations.english: thou permittest fodder to be produced from the earth for cattle

quotations.old_english: Swylce he of ægerum út alǽde
quotations.english: as it from an egg had been brought forth

source_text: a-lǽdan; p. de; pp. ed [a from, lǽdan to lead] I. to lead, lead out, withdraw, take away; ducere, producere, educere :-- Ic alǽdde ðé of lande eduxi te de terra, Ps. Spl. 80, 9: Ps. Th. 80, 10: 142, 12: 103, 14: Cd. 73; Th. 90, 15; Gen. 1495. Ic eom alǽded fram leóhte I am led out from the light, Cd. 217; Th. 275, 27; Sat. 178: Ps. Spl. 108, 22. II. to be produced, brought forth, to grow; produci :-- Ðú of foldan fódder neátum lǽtest alǽdan thou permittest fodder to be produced from the earth for cattle, Ps. Th. 103, 13. Swylce he of ægerum út alǽde as it from an egg had been brought forth, Exon. 593; Th. 214, 3; Ph. 233: 59b; Th. 215, 11; Ph. 251.
